title: Object: Playout (E1)
description: Details about how the impression opportunity is scheduled on a DOOH screen or network. Lives in Imp.playout (target) or Imp.ext.playout (transition).

loopdur.description: Duration of the full content loop in seconds.

slotdur.description: Duration of the ad slot in seconds. Creatives longer than slotdur must not be served.

sov.description: Share of voice offered, decimal between 0 and 1.

plays.description: Number of plays of the creative that one win represents within the time window.

dtstart.description: Start of the playout window, Unix ms. If present, imp.dt should equal dtstart.

dtend.description: End of the playout window, Unix ms.

screens.description: Number of screens covered when a network or package is sold as one unit.
